checks: Receive the parcel is the correct delivery act. Achieve is for goals; belong requires to and denotes ownership; occur is intransitive. Zh-TW and all explanations accurate.

activeQuestion.prompt: The courier could not enter the building because no one was there to ____ the parcel.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 因為無人在場____包裹，快遞無法進入大樓。

options.whyZh: achieve 用於目標或成果，不用於收取包裹。
receive a parcel 表示接收配送的包裹，符合情境。
belong 需搭配 to，且不表示收貨動作。
occur 是不及物動詞，不能直接接 parcel。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: receive a parcel 表示接收配送的包裹，符合情境。
activeQuestion.evidence: no one was there to receive the parcel

vocabulary.note: 負責運送包裹或文件的人或公司。
